topic: How to think about your share of the network
hook: Here is how to think about your chance of finding a block.

scenes.narration: Your chance per block is your share of the total network hashrate.
A small share means a small chance on any single block.
Pools combine many miners and share rewards in proportion to the work each contributed.

cta: Solo or pool? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: How to Think About Your Share of the Network
description_body: Your chance of finding a block equals your share of network hashrate.
